cl_poisoned_desc: You have been poisoned. Drink an antidote or seek medical assistance.
cl_still_poisoned_desc: You are still suffering from poison. Drink an antidote or seek medical assistance.
cl_antidote_used_desc: The antidote is taking effect, you should feel better soon.
sv_antidote_not_needed: You are not poisoned, you don't need this right now.
sv_antidote_in_progress: You are already taking an antidote.
cmd_webhooktest_help: Send a test log to every configured rsg-poison webhook
wh_resumed_desc: A player loaded in while still poisoned; resuming the effect.
wh_antidote_used_desc: A player drank an antidote and is no longer poisoned.
wh_antidote_wasted_desc: Player consumed an antidote but died before it took effect.
wh_antidote_denied_not_poisoned: Player tried to use an antidote while not poisoned. No item taken.
wh_antidote_denied_in_progress: Player tried to use a second antidote while already drinking one. No item taken.
wh_death_desc: A poisoned player died, clearing their poison state.
wh_exploit_invalid_cause: Client reported poisoning with an invalid cause: `%s`.
wh_exploit_forged_cure: Client tried to clear its poison state without a valid antidote or death. The cure was rejected and the player re-poisoned.
cl_cured_desc: Your poison has been treated, you feel the venom leave your body.
